title: ClusterQuest pipeline parameters
description: Phosphonate BGC discovery and characterisation. Generated from nextflow.config by tests/check_schema.py --write; regenerate rather than hand-edit.

antismash_cb_general.description: only when antismash_minimal = false; ClusterBlast: Compare vs antiSMASH DB

antismash_cc_mibig.description: only when antismash_minimal = false; ClusterCompare: Advanced MIBiG scoring

antismash_html.description: Keep antiSMASH's per-genome HTML viewer (index.html, regions.js,

antismash_minimal.description: antiSMASH minimal mode (faster, skips domain analysis)

antismash_phosphonate_neighbourhood.description: Size of the flank antiSMASH keeps around a phosphonate rule core, in kb. Its own rule file says 5, which is too small for this chemistry: on LMG 5342 the region stops 4.2 kb short of the HiVir cluster, so its last four genes are missing fro

antismash_smcog_trees.description: only when antismash_minimal = false; Phylogenetic trees for BGC genes

antismash_summary_gbk.description: Write {genome}.gbk, the whole annotated genome (~11 MB each).

assembly_level.description: Restrict the NCBI download by assembly level, e.g. 'complete' or 'chromosome,complete'. Null takes everything. Useful when taxonomic breadth matters more than exhaustive coverage: Streptomyces has 16,030 GenBank genomes but 1,573 complete o

assembly_source.description: 'GenBank' (GCA_), 'RefSeq' (GCF_) or 'all'. GenBank was hardcoded until 2026-09-23 and remains the default so existing runs reproduce. **RefSeq is the one to use at order scale.** Measured 2026-09-23: Enterobacterales has 1,257,000 GenBank

bigscape_mix.description: Allow mixing BGC classes in same GCF

bigscape_partition.description: BiG-SCAPE compares every BGC against every other and its peak memory is quadratic above ~4,000 BGCs (GB = 1.14 + 1.29e-7*n^2), reaching ~1.9 TB at the 121,000 BGCs a million genomes would yield. Splitting the input by pepM sequence identity

bigscape_partition_identity.description: 0.60-0.80 is the verified safe window. Every same-GCF pair measured had pepM identity >= 0.901, so 0.60 leaves wide margin; 0.90 demonstrably splits real families (23 pairs, ARI 0.974). Failure is silent — a split family looks like two fami

bigscape_partition_max_size.description: Largest partition allowed, as a BGC count. Leave at 0 to derive it from the memory BIGSCAPE_PARTITION is allocated — the cap exists to avoid an OOM kill, so it should follow the allocation rather than be guessed. This is a safety valve, NOT

bigscape_partition_memory_margin.description: Fraction of the allocation to budget when deriving the cap. Deliberately under 1.0 because of that extrapolation: costs ~8% of the cap, buys ~19 GB of headroom at 128 GB, against an OOM that discards hours of clustering.

bigscape_partition_threshold.description: Total BGCs in the run (not base pairs, and not a per-partition size) at which partitioning starts paying. Below it everything goes in one partition and the run behaves as if partitioning were off. Partitioning is a net LOSS at small scale:

bigscape_reference_dir.description: Characterised phosphonate clusters MIBiG does NOT carry, measured against every run so "distance to a known phosphonate BGC" becomes a real column. antiSMASH's KnownClusterBlast cannot supply this: across 334 Erwiniaceae regions its best-hi

check_db_updates.description: Warn (never fail) when a pinned database is behind what upstream offers. One HEAD request per database at startup; set false for offline runs.

count_per_contig.description: Count per contig (true) or per genome (false)

download_batch_size.description: Accessions fetched per FETCH_RENAME_SCREEN task. Sets transient disk, which is download_batch_size x download_max_forks x ~8.7 MB — about 3.5 GB at the defaults, against the 1.3 TB a 150,000-genome taxon used to hold at once.

download_max_forks.description: Concurrent fetch tasks. MEASURED, not guessed: probed against NCBI on 2026-09-23 at 1/2/4/8, throughput peaked at 2 (33.5 MB/s, 159 genomes/min) and DECLINED above it, with zero failures at any level. That is a saturated link, not server th

gtdb_release.description: GTDB-Tk refuses data older than its own

gtdbtk_bgc_genomes_only.description: Only analyze genomes with detected BGCs

input_genomes.description: only for --workflow bgc_analysis; Path to pre-downloaded genomes directory

pepm_prescreen.description: pepM pre-screen: skip antiSMASH on genomes with no PEP mutase, which cannot carry a phosphonate BGC. On by default: validated at 298/298 sensitivity over 2,771 genomes, and it is what makes order-scale runs tractable. Every verdict is publi

pepm_prescreen_min_density.description: proteins/Mb below which a genome is screened by DNA

publish_mode.description: How publishDir moves task output into outdir. 'link' makes hard links, so a published file and its work/ counterpart share one inode: results/ costs no extra disk, and the published copy survives `nextflow clean -f` (verified — the inode's

recover_orfs.description: Genomes are often only partly annotated, and antiSMASH runs its own gene finder ONLY on records with zero CDS features -- so a genome that shipped with some genes keeps only those. Measured on Erwiniaceae: 327 of 333 BGC regions contain a 3

reuse_antismash_from.description: Taxon name to reuse antiSMASH results from, e.g. "Pantoea"

reuse_gtdbtk_from.description: Taxon name to reuse GTDB-Tk results from

skip_tree.description: Skip phylogenetic tree in HTML report visualization

task_batch_size.description: Genomes per task for the short per-genome steps (rename, GenBank→FASTA, antiSMASH result copy). These take 0.2–1.5 s each, so one task per genome is dominated by scheduler overhead; batching cuts job count by this factor.

taxdump_date.description: NCBI monthly archive; the live file changes daily

taxon.description: NCBI taxon (species, genus, family, order, etc.)
